notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.17
notes.content:
Features

New music tracks

Overhauled combat GUI

Upgraded FSR to 3.1.5



Bug Fixes

Orb of Annihilation didn't always deal damage upon detonation



Tweaks/Balance

Revised player hit SFX

Orb of Annihilation increased detonation radius and damage

Minigun augmentation "Harnessed Destruction" - improved bounce trajectory calculations

Saw Blade targeting updates:

    If the blade collides with a structure before hitting an enemy, it will search that collision point for enemy targets

    If no targets are found, the blade will begin returning to the player

    If the blade collides with an enemy while returning to the player, it will acquire targets at the point of collision

Improved enemy flight obstacle avoidance

Improved enemy traversal jumping motions

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.16
notes.content:
Features

Enemies now get staggered and interrupted upon receiving damage

	Staggers are triggered when enemy health falls below certain health thresholds

	Damage source influences the duration of the stagger

Added a setting to adjust overall blood visual levels

Added camera shake to certain events


Bug Fixes

Rifle wouldn't play reload animation in certain scenarios

Launcher wasn't reloading on shoot as expected in certain scenarios


Tweaks/Balance

Added weapon sway relative to camera motion

Improved gun positional rotation relative to recoil when shooting

Further improvements to blood VFX

Improved enemy jump animations

Visual layout improvements to PC control bindings page

Added scale in to enemy orb projectile type attacks

Added more prominent casting SFX to powerful enemy spells

Further improvements to various other VFX

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.15
notes.content:
Features

Enemies now emit light when engaged in combat


Bug Fixes

Enemies could spawn in a locked state in certain scenarios

Player could jump higher than intended when partially on ledges

The same button used to un-pause the game could have it's corresponding action performed

Flyer enemies weren't granting Nanite on kill

Fragmented corpses weren't  having forces applied properly

Damageable non-enemy types no longer spawn hit VFX

Launcher barrel wasn't always returning to the correct position upon reloading

Launcher Barrage augmentation fixes:

    Improved firing of single shots

    You can no longer reload while pre-loading shots

    You can no longer pre-load primary and secondary fire simultaneously


Tweaks/Balance

Increased Minigun primary fire damage and critical hit multiplier

Additional visual improvements for the world

Enemy Shield Barrier's visually reflect damage taken

Various improvements to several VFX

SSAO GFX setting is now off by default

Updated the tutorial menu to better explain the Nanite mechanic

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.14
notes.content:
Features

Added Gamepad aim assist and toggle setting

Added Screen Space Ambient Occlusion GFX setting

All GFX settings changes should no longer require a restart to take effect

Improved visual feedback on successful shots with hitscan and bullet based damage

Certain enemies can now traverse up and down ledges

Added Warp Gate VFX on use

Added VFX to enemies hit by EMP

The current game version is displayed in the pause menu and end of game screen

Added new keyboard control binds:

Toggle UI (Keypad - )

† Take Screenshot (Keypad + ) 



Bug Fixes

Look sensitivity setting wasn't being applied to camera movement

Fixed Malignant Sonar not revealing enemies

Crows would fly in an unexpected manner after the game was un-paused

Critters could experience navigation issues

Improved monster pre-spawning and pooling

You can no longer pause during death or the end game screen

Added extra measures to keep flyer type enemies within the game bounds

Ammo casings discharged after firing weren't behaving properly over time

Sequential texts and timers will now pause/un-pause with the game

Switching to gamepad input will set a menu selection if there isn't one

Switching between input devices will properly update cursor state

Many SFX will now pause and un-pause with the game


Tweaks/Balance

Improved world lighting

Increased the pickup range on Shrine Orb pickups

Added a slight delay to Static Charge detonations

Reduced Shotgun primary fire shrapnel spread

Improved several enemy's animation transitions

Further GUI improvements


† Screenshots are saved to - C:\\Users\\AppData\\LocalLow\\HuxDev\\EXON\\Screenshots

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.13
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where some game state wouldn't reset properly on reloads

Enemy Stalker could teleport outside the level bounds

Anti Aliasing setting dropdown wasn't reflecting the actual value on load

Enemies could play their melee attack SFX more often than intended

Enemies and spawner VFX could orientate to unintended locations

Projectile based weapon spread wasn't working as intended

Some enemies could move during spell casting animations in certain scenarios

Enemy Colossus spell Projectile Nova will now detonate when colliding with terrain or buildings

Enemy ground targeted spells and abilities now properly calculate on non terrain positions

Enemy Flyer's could get stuck outside the level bounds

Enemy Heavy demon melee attack animations weren't transitioning properly

Gun reload cost indicators wouldn't deactivate when switching guns in certain scenarios

Spell Demon shield barrier could remain active if killed during casting animation

Certain objects were allowing the player to jump before being grounded


Tweaks/Balance

Various improvements to the UI and menus

Pistol -

Slightly reduced firing rates

Increased base damage

Increased critical hit multipliers

General Enemy AI -

Flyer type enemies will only attack when facing the player

Repositioning movement will try to maintain line of sight with the player

Better overall transitions out of melee attacks

Improved repositioning behaviour for each difficulty setting

Improved target rotations between movement and attacks

Increased the base nanite gained from enemy kills

Increased Shotgun damage and projectile speeds

Increased enemy Colossus spell cooldown times

Reduced hit detection size for enemy Mutant spell Lightning Strike

Increased the concurrent number of enemies that can be damaged by grenade type weapons

Improved Launcher reload states to match animation timings

Enemy Spell Demon spell Impale now has a fixed target distance and travel speed

Added a music track

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.12
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Improved restart game logic to prevent edge case bugs
 Psionic blast damage multiplier was dealing more damage than intended
 Rifle augmentation "Lightning Conduit" was dealing more damage than intended
 Launcher augmentation "Seeker Missiles" target wasn't always clearing on kill
 Further improvements to Blood splatter rendering issues


Tweaks/Balance

 Siphoning Saw damage increased, now heals on each hit, move speed further increased on successful hit
 Launcher augmentation "Bombardier" changed to - reduces reload cost and reloads instantly
 Smoother crow flight motion
 Improved enemy Flyer movement patterns and obstacle avoidance
 Some player GUI elements will now hide while interact/world space menus are open
 Improved sync and timing of end of game screen components
 Increased projectile speed of Shotgun, Rifle and Minigun
 Pistol augmentation "Sentry Turret" base damage reduced (damage effects unchanged)
 Adjust portal SFX volume
 GFX settings menu now displays a message if a restart is required for new settings to take effect
 Reduced the damage of some high output enemies

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.11
notes.content:
Features

End of game statistics detailing weapon and ability usage

Bug Fixes

 Nanite orbs could linger after the round ends
 Fixed Tutorial menu button control navigation
 Blood wouldn't always clean up properly after the round ends
 Ammo bars could display the wrong values after gaining the Titan Cartridge augmentation
 Empty shells discharged from the Launcher after reload weren't rendering correctly
 Interrupting the Shotgun reload sequence could cause issues in certain scenarios
 Monsters could spawn in unintended locations
 Pistol could be switched out during alternate fire sequence
 Combustion could be cast multiple times before entering cooldown


Tweaks/Balance

 Reworked damage systems
 Critters can now be shot
 Improved enemy hitboxes and hit detection
 Enemies can now be critically hit via head shots
 Additional GUI text animations
 Orb of Annihilation now deals damage upon impact with environment or expiring
 Various player character fixes and improvements
 Updated tutorial controls page to include previous/next weapon bindings
 Rifle augmentation "Lightning Conduit" arc range reduced, and damage dealt by each arc reduced

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.10
notes.content:
Features

 Overhauled level design
 Added Shield shrines
 New gun icon art


Bug Fixes

 Camera look dead zone was applying to mouse
 Shotgun could get stuck in a reload loop if the round ended during reload sequences
 Blood now properly splatters on objects


Tweaks/Balance

 Adjusted muzzle flashes scale and lighting
 Minigun max ammo reduced
 Minigun augmentation "Titan Cartridge" bonus ammo reduced
 Minigun augmentation "Juggernaut" shield gain reduced
 Max concurrent enemy spawns now scales per difficulty
 Improved player animations
 Improved player jumping and gravity
 Improved shrine VFX


Optimizations
Improved occlusion culling

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.9
notes.content:
Features
- Weapon swap overhaul

 Decreased unequip times of all weapons
 Weapon swaps can be now be interrupted by performing another weapon swap
 Revised the timing of GUI elements to better represent when a weapon has completed equipping
 Next and previous weapon can now be selected via Mouse Wheel or controller D-Pad Left or Right


Bug Fixes
- Launcher grenades weren't always colliding with others objects
- Launcher projectile outlines weren't always showing
- Difficulty would default to easy if no difficulty buttons were pressed
- Minigun wasn't reloading when pressing shoot after gaining enough nanite to reload
- Minigun now triggers the proper reload animation sequence when continuing to hold fire

Tweaks
- Improved gunshot recoil animations
- Nanite tutorial text improved for clarity
- You can now reload and use abilities for free between rounds
- Adjusted the position of text tips
- Improved player pickups world GUI position and orientation
- Added tweening for all tutorial pages content
- Added visual markers for nanite orbs generated from kills
- Added gamepad camera look dead zones
- Weapon wheel enhancements

 Inner GUI is now an arrow indicating the current input direction angle
 Improved weapon selection zone calculations
 Increased the selection dead zone when using a mouse
 Added a camera lock delay when switching weapon via weapon wheel on gamepads

- Added copied confirmation text for copy to Discord button
- Launcher augmentation "Seeker Missiles" now has a sticky duration for locked targets
- Improved Rifle secondary fire sniper shot cooldown visuals
- Death sequence now auto reloads the level

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.8
notes.content:
Features

 Added new music tracks
 Added new difficulty level - Very Hard
 Added gamepad controller vibration and toggle setting
 Added UI animations


Bug Fixes

 Enemy markers now set and clear properly between rounds
 Enemies could get stuck holding position
 Enemies could retain old pathing targets
 Debuff particles could persist or renew on dead enemies
 Debuff particles could loop indefinitely
 Player no longer floats near pickups


Tweaks/Balance

 Crimson Combustion radius reduced
 Kills via Crimson Combustion were erroneously generating nanite orbs
 Nanite no longer drains on any difficulty
 Nanite drop amount now scales by difficulty
 Smoothed player animation transitions
 Repositioned Rifle secondary fire sniper shot cooldown bar
 Improved visibility of Launcher projectiles

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.7
notes.content:
Features

 The last few enemies of each round get markers placed on them
 Health and Nanite bars will flash when either resource is gained


Bug Fixes

 Seeker missiles could retain previous targeting info
 Improved collision detection for Rifle and Minigun primary fire and both Launcher projectiles
 Fixed additional object pool issues
 Tips now fit properly on Steam Deck screen
 Spell Demon ability Impale now only deals 1 instance of damage per cast
 Flyer dissolve effect on death fix
 Fragmented corpses weren't always behaving as expected
 Improved jump mechanics and grounded checks, particularly when on slopes
 Mutant wasn't always using cloaking ability upon spawning


Tweaks/Balance

 Ease some effects in/out at the start/end of rounds
 Siphoning Blade size and damage increased
 Misc augmentation "Unrelenting Onslaught" changed to: removes movement penalty for all guns and increases base movement speed
 Pistol augmentation "Sentry Turret" can now shoot multiple enemies within range
 Set frame rate target/limit to max refresh rate
 Flyers max attack range and fly height reduced
 Psionic Blast augmentation "Psionic Evisceration" changed to: blast damage is multiplied for each target hit
 Minigun augmentation "Regenerating Artillery" removed
 New Minigun augmentation "Titan Cartridge" - increases max ammo capacity
 Minigun secondary fire Orb of Annihilation damage is now calculated from base max ammo size
 Improved Minigun secondary fire Orb of Annihilation targeting system
 Enemies will gradually turn towards the player when attacking or casting spells


Optimisations

 Increased GPU Instancing utilisation

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.6
notes.content:
Features

 Added Controls button in pause menu to open controls menu directly
 Added text tips between rounds with toggle setting


Bug Fixes

 Certain enemy spells weren't always dealing damage
 Errors in player pickups text descriptions
 Pistol could reload during alternate fire sequence
 Music wasn't looping, or stopping on death
 All enemy damage output, including spells, are now affected by damage reduction debuffs
 Spell Demon ability Impale now correctly targets a location beyond the player
 Particles weren't always returning to the pool, causing memory leaks
 Enemies weren't behaving in the expected manner on easy and medium difficulties


Tweaks/Balance

 Reduced maximum concurrent monsters count
 Rebalanced rounds - slower introduction of enemy types and more gradual difficulty curve
 Siphoning Blade augmentation "Augmented Reconstruction" removed
 New Siphoning Blade augmentation "Rebalanced Blade" - Siphoning Blade can hit 2 additional enemies
 New Psionic Blast augmentation "Psionic Evisceration" - Hitting 3 or more targets greatly increases blast damage
 Psionic Blast base damage increased
 Rifle augmentation "Penetrating Rounds" removed
 Penetrating Rounds is now included in the Rifle baseline
 New Rifle augmentation "Static Charge" - Rifle secondary kills create a damaging electric pulse. Kills from these pulses trigger additional pulses.
 Minigun secondary fire Orb of Annihilation can no longer bounce off objects
 Minigun augmentation "Magnetic Annihilation" removed
 New Minigun augmentation "Harnessed Destruction" - Orb of Annihilation can bounce off obstacles and duration is extended
 New Minigun augmentation "Juggernaut" - Kills with primary fire grant shield
 New Minigun augmentation "Hyperspin Module" - Reduces barrel wind up time and increases firing rate
 Spell Demon ability Magic Missiles no longer locks onto the player
 Player pickups world GUI nanite cost text color matches other text
 Player pickups world GUI ability nanite cost has scrolling texture and reflects the actual cost
 Player pickups world GUI ability/gun backing circle more prominent

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.5
notes.content:
Features

 Add smoothening/dampening to camera look when using a gamepad
 Add slider setting for maximum standard corpse count
 Add tutorial menu demo videos for orb mechanics
 Show nanite cost for abilities at bottom of GUI card
 Flyer enemies dissolve effect on death if not fragmented
 Add hit VFX for several projectile attacks


Bug Fixes

 Anti Aliasing settings not saving/loading
 Crimson Combustion can't damage enemy shields
 Enemy Colossus movement not locked when casting certain spells
 Augmentation Regenerating Artillery can fire below 0 ammo
 Siphoning Blade can hit more enemies than the intended amount
 Shotgun augmentation Eternal shredder doesn't always proc
 Shotgun augmentation Eternal Shredder procs while reloading could result in reloading past the max ammo count
 Enemy projectiles will now collide properly with terrain and other obstacles


Tweaks/Balance

 Crosshairs changed to opaque teal
 Adjusted post processing to improve visibility in dark areas
 Improved all gunshot SFX
 Steam Deck uses low texture quality by default
 Settings now specifies AMD FSR 3.1
 Colossus will cast Meteor in more scenarios
 Minigun secondary Orb of Annihilation moves faster, has shorter acquisition range and reduced duration
 Adjust damage feedback SFX thresholds and have more distinguished sounds for breakpoints
 Siphoning Blade heals for a greater amount for each target hit
 Enemy barrier damage particles replaced


Optimisations

 Reduced memory usage
 Reduced run time memory allocations/garbage collection
 Reduced render calls

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.4
notes.content:
Features

 Add difficulty settings and menu
 Improved feedback for gun shot hits
 Implement AMD FSR 3.1 and add dropdown selection setting
 Disable look while weapon wheel is open
 Add look inversion toggle setting
 Add disable auto reload toggle setting
 Add max fragmented corpse setting slider
 Set audio source priorities


Bugs

 Launcher shots not firing in the expected direction
 Remove duplicate entries from screen resolution dropdown
 Trail renderers tracking old coordinates
 Minigun secondary fire bug with Magnetic Annihilation augmentation
 Ability glyphs showing KB&M on Steam Deck/controller upon reload
 Enemies could spawn with spells disabled
 Reset weapon wheel upon selection on gamepads
 Weapon wheel will correctly display no selection
 Weapon wheel selections highlights off on start
 Shotgun reload issues
 Launcher preloading ammo could deduct ammo without adding it to the preloaded count
 Launcher doesn't always auto reload when nanite available
 Launcher can occasionally shoot an additional shot on the last round of ammo
 Insufficient nanite indicator could overlap itself and become hidden


Tweaks/Balance

 Increase Pistol damage
 Reduce Launcher self damage
 Increase augmentation EMP blast radius
 Increase range enemies will engage in melee attacks


Optimisations

 Various performance optimisations
